details.reason: The keyframe satisfies all six continuity and production design standards. Samurai Kenji is bareheaded with tied-back hair, uninjured, positioned on screen-left facing right. Mecha-Dragon Kuroryu features two fully fully-rendered biomechanical wings with physical smoke and light emitting directly from its circular chest core. The setting correctly presents the stone courtyard flanked by shrine buildings and lanterns in a single widescreen frame.
